Question 18
?

The charge C of a phone battery decreases at a rate that's inversely proportional to the time t spent charging the smartphone. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the charge C of the phone battery?

a
dCdt=kt,k>0
b
dCdt=−kC,k>0
c
dCdt=−kt,k>0
d
dCdt=−kC,k>0
e
dCdt=kt,k>0
